description:
Create a Causal Loop Diagram (CLD) visualizing three major climate feedback loops in draw.io.

A text file with the specific loops and polarities is provided on the Desktop at '~/Desktop/feedback_loops_data.txt'.

Your task:
1. Open draw.io (already running) and create a new diagram.
2. Create a Causal Loop Diagram centered on 'Global Mean Temperature'.
3. Visualize these three loops based on the text file:
   - Loop 1: Ice-Albedo Feedback (Temperature -> Sea Ice -> Albedo -> Absorption -> Temperature)
   - Loop 2: Permafrost Carbon Feedback (Temperature -> Permafrost -> CO2/Methane -> Greenhouse -> Temperature)
   - Loop 3: Water Vapor Feedback (Temperature -> Evaporation -> Water Vapor -> Greenhouse -> Temperature)
4. Use CURVED connectors for all relationships.
5. Add text labels '+' (same direction) or '-' (opposite direction) to every arrow based on the data file.
6. Add a 'R' (Reinforcing) label inside each of the three loops.
7. Save the diagram as '~/Desktop/climate_loops.drawio'.
8. Export the diagram as a PNG image to '~/Desktop/climate_loops.png'.
